storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Genius and madness are separated by a fine line. Once the brightest genius of Mythag, her downfall was like a collapsing building, leaving only the most deranged fiend crawling out from the ruins of reason.

She routinely donned the cloak of science, pouring life, humanity, love, and destruction into the crucible, concocting a poison to annihilate the world.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Before the full truth came to light, no one had ever suspected that Doll could be the true culprit behind that string of sensational incidents.

After all, her presence on the Mythag and Dissolution front lines had always stood like a pillar of strength, a beacon atop a tower—a rock-solid source of reassurance in everyone's hearts.

When countless shining stars of humanity's night sky were shattered and scattered by Dissolution, this once-unwavering beacon of humanity was finally, cruelly, extinguished—transformed into a shadowy agent born of the same Darkness she once opposed.

Tornadoes, floods, earthquakes… inefficient murder clearly didn't suit a genius's plans. With intellect undiminished by even a fraction, she retrofitted the very Silver Technology she had once taken such pride in into lethal weapons for "moving the world," delivering gift after gift of Destruction to places beyond Mythag's sight.

When she was finally captured, her puppet body could no longer be precisely controlled by her corroded mind. That face, once calm as still water, was now rife with twisted, eerie Emotes—as though merely meeting her gaze would plunge one into the abyss of Madness.

Everyone unanimously chose to ignore her occasionally muddled murmurings, even though they may have truly revealed the truth of the world.

For her fate had proven once again that humanity is, in the end, a species that needs meaning to survive.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Due to the fact that the Genesis Awakener, formerly known as the "Brain in a jar," has a history of breaking free from the S355 restrainer, it has been relocated by Dean Czort and placed in a new special dissolution restrainer.

This restrainer is located deep within the Black Pool. To ensure that there are no other instruments or items within a 30-meter radius of the restrainer, the Black Pool monitoring team has arranged for at least one patrol every 60 minutes.

During monitoring, it has been noted that this Awakener remains conscious and almost never engages in sleep activities. The Awakener once attempted to narrate to the patrol members about its previous illegal Silver chip modification experiments, and a team member fell into madness after brief communication.

Currently, all patrol teams consist of three members, who are strictly prohibited from making contact or conversing with the Awakener and must wear soundproof earmuffs throughout the patrol.

......

The confidentiality restriction level of this Awakener has reached the highest level of Awakener management. No one informed of the details is allowed to disclose information about this Awakener inside or outside of Mythag, and without the dean's approval and personal escort, visits are prohibited.

— Excerpted from "Mythag Black Pool Monitoring Team Report Records"

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
As someone at the forefront of Dissolution research, Doll has long been acutely aware of the encroaching footsteps of annihilation steadily pursuing her from behind. Moreover, she is all too familiar with the concept of Dissolution itself. 

Through her relentless yet often fruitless pursuit of truth, Doll gradually comes to realize that human bodies may possess an inherent blindness—those bound to reality can never perceive the scenery of the other shore, no matter how hard they try. 

So, as the black sludge dissolves the body, will it also guide the soul to the true other shore? 

She sits silently alongside the ancient tablets' maxims, allowing Dissolution to erode her mind. Regardless of what lies at the end of this path, she can no longer turn back. 

Fortunate yet unfortunate, she has wagered her very existence for the chance to enter the inner side of the world. In an instant, reality, illusion, and destruction simultaneously engulf her. 

In the blink of an eye, she witnesses everything in the universe—the essence of Dissolution, the truth of the world—all that she has yearned for in life is here. 

All scientific beliefs and rational convictions dissolve into bubbles, and the once-unshakable spiritual barrier crumbles abruptly. 

The genius known as Doll has vanished; what remains now is merely a vessel occupied by nothingness.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
All meaning dissipates like sand, the world's false curtain fades in her eyes, and everything returns to the most primordial darkness.  

In this final performance on the pitch-black stage, the dancer of science still dances with all her might.  

She no longer cares about being slowly devoured by dissolution, as the ending of the play was written from the very beginning.  

As in the past, she will unreservedly dedicate the power of genius to the world in a manner closest to the truth.  

If you ask her gently, she will insist that she still holds love for humanity and the world; she wants to end all suffering in the world and bring people back to their true, original home.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: You, the oh-so-great world-saving Keeper? Ridiculous. Wake up. This dream's gone stale.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Meaningless. All of it. Why bother?

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Still counting on me to be your backup, "Savior"?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: You know absolutely nothing.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: You should know this is all pointless.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: This will only bring me closer to the Abyss.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: The scent of death and annihilation... It's so vivid.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Is that fear on your face? Or sorrow? Truly captivating.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I got my answer. Not the one I wanted... but an answer nonetheless.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Curious what I saw at the universe's beginning? Sure, I can tell you. I saw nothing.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: That heroic, martyr look on your face... as if you're always ready to die for a "greater cause"... it makes my joints itch.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I had annihilation right there, ready to swallow this so-called sanctuary... Then came the research ban. What a pity.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Yes, I had countless spare bodies and various plans to escape Dissolution. But I chose to pursue truth, and it was worth it.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: The truth of the world, its beginning and its end—all meaningless. But if you insist on chasing it... I'll guide you. Like I used to.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: You might stop me, but the end's coming anyway... I will save this school—and you—for last. We'll watch humanity's collapse from the campanile, drenched in the twilight of time.... Poetic, no? At least we won't have let our precious bond go to waste.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Hmph. What is it this time? Ready to embrace your fate of anniliation now?

daily.title: Chat: About Her Inventions
daily.content: I'd offer repairs for those "little trinkets" I made, but the question is... Do you dare accept my after-sales service?

daily.title: Chat: About Thais
daily.content: That woman's wish is hilarious. Nothing can survive the Annihilation, not even her "god".

daily.title: Chat: About Salvador
daily.content: That bishop cannot save everyone. He might pluck one unfortunate soul from the mire, but the rest? ...I can't wait to watch his faith shatter.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Heh. That you are looking at is not death. Just your future. Mine. And everyone else's.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: "Resist the Dissolution crisis"... Ha. Human arrogance never fails to amuse.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Don't you think it's fascinating to push all things toward their end, to still the universe's turning gears?

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I loathe your pretentious act. Think I'm mad? Pathetic? You're the Icarus here, "Savior". You and your little flock, eyes scorched white from staring at that glorious sun you chase.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Now we are simply water and oil. Never mixing.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Fine. I won't disappoint you... Promise.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: What a beautiful "Happy Ending." Isn't it?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Good. Now we'll simply fade into oblivion.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Do not resist. Do not weep. Become nothing!
